description.narrative:
The general objective of the contribution is to promote democratic, egalitarian, inclusive, and representative decision-making processes at the regional level. The specific objective is to strengthen gender parity in democracy at all levels of participation and decision-making in the public and political life of women in Latin America. These objectives will be achieved through three results:
Result 1: Feminist and women's organizations expand political rights in favor of women through democratic frameworks and public policies aimed at achieving substantive equality.
Result 2: Strengthened coordinated advocacy among feminist movements, alliances, diverse feminist and women's expressions, and other allied actors for the adoption of global standards that consolidate Gender Parity Democracy.
Result 3: A strengthened regional civic agenda for democracy based on the principles of justice, gender parity, and secularism.

The title of the contribution is: Parity Program for the Strengthening of the substantive participation of women, in their diversity, in Latin America and the Caribbean,
The Overall Objective is to promote democratic, egalitarian, inclusive and representative decision-making processes at the regional level.
The Specific Objective is to improve the application of substantive parity at all levels of participation and decision-making in the public, economic and political life of women in Latin America.
The programme has a regional perspective by addressing some of the challenges to achieving substantive democracies and parity that transcend national boundaries but are common to countries. In summary, it seeks to:
-Strengthen regional actors and solutions and capacity for cooperation in the region, in particular for gender equality and women's empowerment through targeted training for women from civil society organizations and women in decision-making positions (in legislative, executive, and judicial branches) to equip them with tools and knowledge to advance the definition and implementation of regional and national agendas on women's rights and the fight against violence.
-Strengthen the conditions for political participation, exercise of citizenship, transparency, and accountability through direct support to civil society networks and organizations to advance their agendas for the promotion, exercise, and defense of their rights (including Afro-descendant women, rural women and youth).
-Enhance capacities, cooperation and dialogue between civil society actors with national and regional institutions. Contribute to cultural change through the promotion of positive messages on gender equality, justice, democracy and the secular state.

Titeln på bidraget: Jämställdhetsprogram för att stärka kvinnors, i deras mångfald, reella deltagande i Latinamerika och Karibien. Det övergripande målet är att främja demokratiska, jämlika, inkluderande och representativa beslutsprocesser på regional nivå. Det specifika målet är att förbättra tillämpningen av faktisk jämställdhet på alla nivåer av deltagande och beslutsfattande i det offentliga, ekonomiska och politiska livet för kvinnor i Latinamerika. Programmet har ett regionalt perspektiv då det adresserar några av de existerande utmaningarna för att uppnå demokrati och jämlikhet som överskrider nationella gränser och som är gemensamma för olika länder. Sammanfattningsvis syftar programmet till att: -Stärka regionala aktörer samt utveckla lösningar och kapacitet för samarbete i regionen, med särskilt fokus på jämställdhet och kvinnors egenmakt. Detta ska uppnås genom riktad utbildning för kvinnor från civilsamhällesorganisationer och kvinnor i beslutsfattande positioner (inom lagstiftande, verkställande och dömande makten) för att ge dem verktyg och kunskap att främja och genomföra regionala och nationella agendor för kvinnors rättigheter och bekämpning av våld. -Stärka förutsättningarna för politiskt deltagande, utövande av medborgarskap, transparens och ansvarsskyldighet genom direkt stöd till civilsamhällets nätverk och organisationer för att främja deras agendor för främjande, utövande och försvar av deras rättigheter (inklusive kvinnor med afrikanskt ursprung, kvinnor på landsbygden och ungdomar). -Stärka kapacitet, samarbete och dialog mellan civilsamhällets aktörer och nationella och regionala institutioner. Bidra till kulturell förändring genom att främja positiva budskap om jämställdhet, rättvisa, demokrati och den sekulära staten.

description.narrative:
The implementation of the Parity Program officially began in July 2024, launching with a three-month inception phase dedicated to revising and strengthening core program documents. This phase focused on updating the theory of change, refining the results framework, planning activities, aligning financial programming, and restructuring the programs governance model.
According to Diakonias first six-month report, notable progress was made across the three agreed program results. Under Result 1, the program advanced womens capacities to exercise their political rights by delivering four regional feminist political education courses. These were developed in partnership with the digital platform ATENEAan alliance of UN Women, UNDP, and FLACSO Argentinaand addressed key topics such as gender equality policies, gender parity in parliaments, and violence against women in politics. The courses enrolled over 1,900 participants, of whom 1,173 completed the training (59.45%). Among them, 405 were women in political decision-making roles, surpassing the programs three-year target. An evaluation conducted by the organizers showed that 90% of women who completed the courses reported improvements in their knowledge, attitudes, and practices related to gender equality. The program also prioritized diversity, with 27% of participants identifying as Indigenous, 11% as Afro-descendant, and 11% as young women.
Under Result 2, the program supported advocacy strategies aimed at promoting the adoption of regional and global standards on gender parity in democratic processes. During the 16 Days of Activism against Gender-Based Violence, partner womens organizations implemented community-based actions in Bolivia, Colombia, El Salvador, Mexico, and Peru, reaching over 800 individuals. Moreover, advocacy efforts contributed to the integration of gender equality measures into local development plans in Colombia and the advancement of legal reform proposals in Mexico and Peru to strengthen gender equality frameworks.
Under Result 3, the program made strides in positioning gender parity as a foundational principle of democracy within national and international public agendas. CLADEM led targeted communication strategies in Bolivia, El Salvador, and Mexico, which included the dissemination of digital publications, social media campaigns, public mobilizations, and intergenerational dialogues on democracy, violence, and gender justice. The program also participated in key international forums such as the Regional Conference on Women, the Summit of the Future, and the Forum of the Commission on the Status of Women for Latin America and the Caribbean. These efforts significantly enhanced the programs visibility and strategic influence at both regional and global levels.
